# SM3HA

> Arabic-first music discovery and media catalog website.

## Public pages
- / — Homepage and search entry point
- /s/{keyword} — Dynamic keyword/result landing pages backed by the public catalog
- /artists — Artist discovery
- /albums — Album discovery
- /search — Search interface
- /trending — Trending catalog content

## URL rules
- Public keyword pages use readable Arabic slugs under `/s/`.
- Only keywords backed by real catalog results should be promoted for indexing.
- Temporary media/download endpoints are not public content pages and should not be indexed.

## SEO
- Canonical public URLs use the production site origin.
- XML sitemap is generated from indexable catalog/keyword data.
- robots.txt allows public catalog pages and blocks admin/API/media surfaces.

## Content
- Catalog pages should expose real metadata such as title, artist, duration and artwork.
- Do not represent empty or unavailable results as substantive content.
